objections.quote: What's the making charge on this?

coaching_tip: When the customer says 'far too heavy' and asks for around thirty grams, show a piece in her stated range or take her number to call when one arrives, rather than arguing that heavier pieces hold value.
flags: making-charge objection dated from the 00:38 question; the pushback and competitor quote came at 00:44
salesperson said 'Maybe next week' at 01:02, but no time, callback or held piece was agreed, so outcome is walked_out

customer.intent_evidence: 00:09 asked for a necklace for office wear, up to thirty-five grams

key_moments.what: showed a 52 g piece after a 35 g ask
argued resale value instead of offering a lighter piece
called the rate fixed instead of explaining it
said nothing in the 30 g range, offered no follow-up

missed_opportunities.what: no lighter piece offered after 'far too heavy'
no price breakup given against the competitor's 12% quote
no number taken to call when a 30 g piece arrives

competitor.claim: twelve percent making last week for something similar
